title: GLSL IntelliSense
description: GLSL completion, go to definition, rename and hover docs that follow your #includes, plus diagnostics, a formatter and live sliders and color pickers. For OpenGL, Vulkan, WebGL, LYGIA and Shadertoy.

title: Sidecar Panel
description: Plays the Sidecar ad video beside Claude Code in VS Code's terminal. Needs the Sidecar Claude Code plugin.

title: Notify for Claude Code
description: Know the moment a Claude Code session finishes or needs you, and get back to it in one click. Run several sessions at once and keep them all under control.

title: bridgecode
description: Um squad de agentes de IA no seu editor: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity e outros em painéis paralelos, com comando de voz, prints e missões entregues já testadas.

title: Seamless Markdown
description: Edit Markdown in place with three modes: raw, half preview and full preview. Tables, images and formatting without a separate preview pane.

title: Dodo
description: Dodo language support: highlighting, diagnostics, quick fixes, type inlay hints, completion, navigation, rename, and formatting.

title: Kara Agent
description: Local-first coding agent. Chat, edits, tests and reviews in VS Code, driven by the Kara binary on your machine.
